conflicts.issue: Dedicated, embedded and integrated operations teams are alternatives. The article does not mandate a new department or consolidate function-owned repositories.
Champion programs require leadership sponsorship, participant time and receptive culture. Solo or resource-constrained maintainers may not have those preconditions.
Incentives, launch events, tool previews and external services can involve spend or permissions; source recommendations grant neither.
Peer advocacy is ongoing and voluntary; protect primary work and provide a bounded succession path rather than indefinite additional workload.
Tool presence, adoption counts and promotion do not demonstrate DevOps practice or measured productivity improvement.
